title: Oil-Free Vegan Coconut Cream Pie
description: A no-bake pie with a chewy toasted-coconut-and-date crust and a silky vanilla coconut-cream filling set with agar. Pure coconut from top to bottom, with no grains or nuts.
watch: Check coconut butter and coconut chips are processed in a nut-free facility.

title: Creamy Gluten-Free and Vegan Key Lime Pie
description: A tart, custardy lime filling made from coconut milk and cornstarch, folded with coconut whip and poured into a cookie crust. No cashews and no tofu, just a bright, creamy slice.
swaps: Use oat milk (not almond) for the dairy-free milk; use 2 Tbsp coconut oil in the crust in place of the dairy-free butter, or a nut-free vegan butter.
watch: Crust cookies must be egg-free and nut-free (the author warns Glutino sandwich cookies contain egg and MiDel crusts are now made in a facility with tree nuts). Confirm CocoWhip label.

title: Gluten Free Vegan Tres Leches Cake
description: A light sponge soaked overnight in a trio of plant milks and crowned with coconut whipped cream and toasted coconut. Tender, milky and made for a crowd.
swaps: Use the egg replacer or 6 Tbsp aquafaba option (not eggs); use vanilla extract, not almond extract; use coconut or oat milk everywhere almond/cashew/macadamia milk is offered (cake and soak); use coconut milk creamer, not almond creamer; skip the sliced almonds and top with toasted coconut only.
watch: If using the vanilla-pudding shortcut instead of milk powder, confirm it is dairy-free. Check that the GF flour blend is nut-free.

title: Vegan Flan
description: Glossy amber caramel over a wobbly coconut-milk custard set with agar, made by a Mexican cook who knows her flan. Unmolds beautifully for an elegant finish.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free oat milk (or more coconut milk/soy milk).

title: Vegan Pavlova
time: 5 hr (incl. aquafaba reduction and slow bake)
description: A crisp-shelled, marshmallowy aquafaba meringue piled with whipped cream and fresh berries. A showstopper that no one will guess is egg-free.
swaps: Top with coconut whipped cream.
watch: The linked whipped cream recipe is separate; make sure your whipped topping is coconut-based and nut-free.

title: Vegan Crème Brûlée
description: Thick coconut cream and vanilla thickened into a silky custard, chilled in ramekins and torched to a crackly sugar crust. A classic bistro dessert for two-person nights.
swaps: Use soy or oat milk instead of almond milk (the author's stated nut-free swap).

title: Strawberry Mochi (Ichigo Daifuku)
description: Whole strawberries wrapped in sweet red bean paste and soft, stretchy shiratamako mochi. Naturally free of wheat, eggs and dairy, and a pretty spring treat.
watch: Check store-bought anko and sweet rice flour labels for wheat or nut cross-contact warnings.

title: Gluten Free Red Velvet Cupcakes (Vegan, Egg-Free)
description: Tender cocoa-kissed cupcakes colored naturally with beet purée, finished with a fluffy dairy-free frosting. From an allergy-focused baker, so no eggs, nuts or dairy.
watch: The flour blend and frosting are linked recipes; use a nut-free GF blend and a nut-free vegan butter/shortening for the frosting.

title: Coconut Cream Cinnamon Coffee Cake (Gluten Free Vegan)
description: A moist coconut-cream snack cake under a thick cinnamon-sugar crumb. Easy enough for a weeknight and great with coffee the next morning.
swaps: Use a gluten-free white flour blend (not all-purpose); use the applesauce egg substitute; use a nut-free nondairy butter in the crumb.

title: Gluten-Free Vegan Lava Cakes
description: Individual chocolate cakes with soft, molten middles, bound with flax and studded with dark chocolate. Ready in under half an hour, so ideal for a last-minute date night.
swaps: Use the flax-egg version.
watch: Use allergy-safe chocolate (the author uses Enjoy Life dark morsels).

title: Chocolate Espresso Vegan Donuts
description: Baked chocolate donuts with a hint of espresso and a glossy chocolate dip. A grown-up treat for brunch or dessert.
swaps: Use oat, soy or coconut milk (the author usually uses almond milk).
watch: Use allergy-safe chocolate chips such as Enjoy Life; use a nut-free GF flour blend.

title: Gluten Free Vegan Cherry Pie
description: A flaky sorghum-and-millet crust wrapped around a jammy tart-cherry filling. A classic double-crust pie for holidays, without eggs or dairy.
swaps: Replace the 1/4 tsp almond extract with vanilla extract (or omit).
watch: Use a nut-free vegan butter in the filling.

title: Vegan and Gluten Free Tiramisu
description: Coffee-and-brandy-soaked aquafaba sponge layered with a rich dairy-free mascarpone-style cream and dusted with cocoa. An egg-free version of the Italian classic for dinner parties.
swaps: Use alcohol-free brandy flavoring if preferred (check it is GF).
watch: Dairy-free cream cheese, double cream and condensed milk are often cashew- or almond-based; choose nut-free brands (e.g., coconut-based cream and condensed coconut milk). Check GF self-raising flour is nut-free.

title: Lemon Popsicles
description: Frozen lemonade on a stick: fresh lemon juice, zest and a little honey or maple. Four ingredients and perfect on a hot day.

title: Vegan Gelato (Chocolate)
description: Dense, intensely chocolatey gelato built on coconut milk and sweetened with dates and coconut sugar. Rich enough for dessert guests, simple enough for a weeknight.

title: Berry Bars (Gluten-Free/Vegan Option)
description: A buttery oat crumble base and topping sandwiching juicy blueberries and jam. A potluck-friendly bar that also works as a picnic dessert.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free oats, Bob's Red Mill 1-to-1 GF flour, and the coconut oil option (not butter).
watch: Oats must be certified gluten-free.

title: Mango Sticky Rice
description: Sweet, salty coconut sticky rice served warm with ripe mango slices and a sprinkle of sesame. The classic Thai street dessert, naturally gluten-free.
swaps: Replace the 1/4 cup condensed milk with sweetened condensed coconut milk.

title: Kinako Dango (Sweet Soy Flour Dumplings)
description: Chewy rice-flour dumplings rolled in sweet, nutty-tasting roasted soybean flour. A quick, unusual treat with only five ingredients.
watch: Contains soy (kinako). Check that the dango flour is pure rice flour.

title: Aquafaba Whipped Topping or Meringues
description: Chickpea liquid whipped with sugar and cream of tartar into a fluffy topping, or baked low and slow into crisp meringue kisses. Free of all top allergens.

title: Gluten Free Vegan Funfetti Cupcakes
description: Fluffy vanilla cupcakes speckled with sprinkles and piled high with vanilla buttercream. Built for birthday parties.
watch: Use a nut-free nondairy milk (oat, soy or hemp) and a nut-free vegan butter; the author recommends Sprinklez (Edward & Sons) as the safest sprinkles.

title: Gluten-Free Vegan Lemon Blackberry Cupcakes
description: Zingy lemon cupcakes filled with a quick blackberry compote and topped with sunny lemon frosting. Bright and springy, and good for showers and brunches.
watch: Use an egg-free vegan mayonnaise and a nut-free nondairy milk.

title: Gluten Free Shortbread Petticoat Tails (Dairy-Free Option)
description: Classic Scottish shortbread baked as a round and cut into crisp, sugar-dusted wedges. Lovely in a holiday cookie tin.
swaps: Use a dairy-free block butter (the author suggests Flora Plant or Stork vegan blocks).
watch: Use a nut-free GF flour blend (the author's blend or Doves Freee).

title: Gluten Free Jammie Dodgers (Egg Free, Vegan Option)
description: Buttery sandwich cookies with a jammy heart peeking through the top. The vegan version has its own tested measurements.
swaps: Follow the vegan version with dairy-free block butter (e.g., Flora or Stork vegan blocks); use vanilla, not almond, extract.
watch: Use a nut-free GF flour blend.

title: Nut-Free & Dairy-Free Baked Cheesecake
description: A creamy, tangy baked cheesecake made from sunflower seed butter and dairy-free yogurt over a pumpkin-seed and date crust. No cashews, no grains.
watch: Use a coconut-based (nut-free) dairy-free yogurt; check sunflower butter labels for cross-contact.

title: Homemade Vegan Plum Sorbet
description: Ripe plums blended with agave and frozen into a jewel-toned, tangy-sweet sorbet. Three ingredients and a lovely palate cleanser after a big dinner.

title: Tahini Chocolate Fudge
description: Silky freezer fudge made from tahini, cacao and maple. A nut-free little bite to pass around after dinner.

title: Dark Chocolate Silk Pie
description: A flaky GF crust filled with a dense, velvety dark-chocolate and sunflower-butter filling. A rich slice for chocolate lovers.
watch: Use a nut-free dairy-free milk (oat or soy) and a nut-free vegan butter; Enjoy Life chocolate is top-allergen free.

title: Raspberry White Chocolate Mousse
description: A two-ingredient white chocolate mousse layered with a fresh raspberry sauce in glasses. Elegant and almost effortless.
watch: Use a coconut- or soy-based dairy-free yogurt (not almond or cashew).

title: Reindeer Brownies
description: Fudgy flax-egg brownies decorated as reindeer with GF pretzel antlers and candy noses. A festive project for kids.
watch: Use certified GF pretzels, a nut-free vegan butter, and allergy-friendly candy eyes; check the GF flour is nut-free.

title: Vegan Butter Mochi (Gluten-Free)
description: Hawaiian-style butter mochi: chewy, custardy squares with crisp golden edges, made with coconut milk and glutinous rice flour.
swaps: Use sunflower seed butter or tahini instead of cashew butter (the author's nut-free option); use oat, soy or coconut milk instead of almond milk.

title: Vegan Caramel Sauce (Gluten-Free)
description: A quick, glossy caramel sauce made with coconut sugar and a creamy base. Drizzle it over ice cream, apple crisp or pancakes.
swaps: Use coconut butter (or sunflower seed butter) instead of cashew butter, per the author's nut-free option; use oat or coconut milk instead of almond milk.

title: Ohagi (Japanese Sweet Rice Balls)
description: Soft pounded sweet rice wrapped in a thick blanket of red bean paste. A traditional Japanese sweet that is naturally vegan and gluten-free.
watch: Check store-bought anko labels.

title: Easy Gluten-Free Lemon Shortbread Cookies
description: Melt-in-your-mouth lemon shortbread rounds with a tangy lemonade glaze. Easy to bake ahead for showers and cookie trays.
swaps: Use vegan butter (the author tested Earth Balance) instead of butter and chill the dough 10–15 minutes longer.
watch: Use a nut-free GF blend (the author tested King Arthur Measure for Measure).

title: Gluten Free Plum Upside Down Cake
description: Halved plums caramelize into a ruby-red topping over a soft, egg-free vanilla sponge. A rustic cake that looks impressive when flipped.
watch: Use soy or oat milk (not nut milk), a nut-free dairy-free butter, and a nut-free GF self-raising flour.

title: Dairy Free Fudge Cupcakes with Caramel
description: Vanilla cupcakes studded with dairy-free fudge, swirled with buttercream and drizzled with homemade caramel. An indulgent bake-sale or birthday treat.
swaps: Use the dairy-free butter and soy milk options throughout.
watch: Dairy-free fudge must be nut-free; use a nut-free plant butter and GF self-raising flour.

title: Allergy-Friendly Spritz Cookies
description: Pressed butter-style cookies made egg-free, sized for piling onto holiday trays. Tint and sprinkle them for any season.
swaps: Use a gluten-free all-purpose flour mix (the page's listed substitution) instead of flour; use a milk-free, nut-free margarine.

title: Sweet Bananas in Coconut Milk
description: Bananas simmered in salted, sweetened coconut milk and topped with toasted sesame. A cozy Thai dessert for two, made in 15 minutes.
swaps: Omit the optional chestnuts.

title: Gluten Free Funnel Cake
description: Lacy, crisp fried funnel cakes showered in powdered sugar, like a trip to the fair. Ready in under 15 minutes.
swaps: Use 1/4 cup applesauce instead of the egg (the author's stated substitute); use coconut milk, not almond.
watch: Check the GF flour blend is nut-free.

title: Gluten Free Churros
description: Crisp ridged churros fried golden and rolled in cinnamon sugar. Serve warm with a chocolate dipping sauce.
swaps: Use the egg replacer option (not eggs); use a nut-free non-dairy milk (oat, soy or coconut) and dairy-free butter sticks (the author suggests Earth Balance).
watch: Egg-replacer churros may be slightly less puffy. Check the GF flour blend is nut-free.

title: Chocolate-Dipped Coconut Macaroons
description: Chewy coconut macaroons bound with coconut milk and psyllium instead of egg whites, with chocolate-dipped bottoms. Five ingredients and very little effort.
watch: Use allergy-safe dark chocolate chips (e.g., Enjoy Life).
